title: Parallel First
text: Calculate the 6 Ω || 12 Ω combination: Rp = (6×12)/(6+12) = 72/18 = 4 Ω. Notice this is less than both 6 Ω and 12 Ω.

title: Then Series
text: Now add the parallel result to the 4 Ω in series: R_total = 4 Ω + 4 Ω = 8 Ω.

title: Check Your Answer
text: The total resistance (8 Ω) should be greater than the parallel combination alone (4 Ω) since series resistors add. It should be less than all three in series (22 Ω).
